title: NASA's 7 Minutes of Terror on Mars #Shorts
description:
Entering the Martian atmosphere at twelve thousand miles per hour, spacecraft endure temperatures hotter than the surface of the Sun. In just seven minutes, a supersonic parachute deploys, rocket thrusters ignite, and a hovering Sky Crane lowers the rover directly onto the red soil. Because radio signals take eleven minutes to reach Earth, the entire landing is controlled autonomously by artificial intelligence. Subscribe to SciBytes for more mind-blowing space exploration!
